item.name: Gabbiano Mataro hairdressing chair black
item.description:
Gabbiano is a luxury brand of hairdressing equipment and furniture, which is distinguished by reliability, quality and aesthetics of workmanship and high comfort of use. It offers a large selection of functional salon equipment such as chairs, washers and infrazones.

Minimalist hairdressing chair with hydraulic lift

The Gabbiano Mataro hairdressing chair combines simple design with practical solutions. Equipped with an efficient hydraulic lift, it allows for smooth height adjustment, making it easy to adjust the position to the stylist's needs. The comfortable seat and ergonomic shape ensure comfort even during long treatments, while the minimalist design adds an elegant and modern touch to the interior. 

Efficiency and comfort at work

The durable hydraulic lift allows for seat height adjustment from 50 to 64 cm, even during use. This makes work more ergonomic and less strenuous, and the position can be adjusted to suit both the hairdresser's and the customer's height. The comfortable backrest provides stable back support and facilitates a comfortable position, which is especially important during long treatments, increasing customer comfort and satisfaction. 

Well-thought-out solutions

Ergonomic armrests support the client's correct posture, ensuring comfort and facilitating precise cutting and styling. The full rotation mechanism provides greater mobility and freedom of movement, making hairdressing work smoother, more efficient, and less strenuous. A practical opening between the backrest and seat facilitates cleaning and quick hair removal from hard-to-reach areas. This allows for efficient and hygienic preparation of the salon for the next client. 

Elegant minimalism

The Gabbiano Mataro hairdressing chair combines modern simplicity with functionality. Its subtly rounded lines give it a lightness, while the stable, round base in matte black emphasises its professional look. The seat, finished with soft-touch synthetic leather in shades of black, ensures comfort even during long treatments. Carefully selected materials ensure durability, moisture resistance, and ease of cleaning. The chair fits perfectly with both modern and classic interiors, emphasising the style and character of the salon. 

Detailed dimensions are provided in the photo.
Includes: seat, actuator with base.

Specifications:
Lift: hydraulic
Base: round
Upholstery material: synthetic leather
Upholstery colour: shades of black
Base colour: shades of black

item.name: Gabbiano hairdressing wash unit Mataro black
item.description:
Gabbiano is a luxury brand of hairdressing equipment and furniture, which is distinguished by reliability, quality and aesthetics of workmanship, as well as high comfort of use. The offer includes a large selection of functional salon equipment such as chairs, washers and infrazones.

Elegant hair wash unit

The Gabbiano Mataro hair wash unit combines functionality, comfort and modern design. The simple, minimalist chair with an interestingly rounded seat allows for comfortable hair care treatments and hair washing. The integrated structure and ergonomic seat shape ensure client comfort while also supporting the hairdresser's workflow. The stylish form emphasises the character of the interior, adding a professional, contemporary look. 

User comfort

The deep, ceramic bowl in shades of black reduces splashing of water and cosmetics used during treatments. The adjustable tilt angle allows for customization to individual needs. The durable material is resistant to stains, scratches, and chemicals, and the smooth surface makes it easy to clean. The ergonomically contoured collar provides comfortable head support.

Well-thought-out amenities and accessories

The wash unit is equipped with a mixer tap that provides constant access to hot and cold water and allows for easy temperature adjustment to the client's needs. A practical place to put the shower head helps keep the work area tidy, while a plug with a special strainer makes it easy to control the water flow and maintain hygiene. The water connection is located inside the base, aesthetically concealing the plumbing. The minimalist chair is designed with the comfort of both client and hairdresser in mind. The combination of functional solutions and ergonomic details ensures that daily work is smooth and comfortable. 

Functional piece of furniture with an elegant design

This minimalist chair with a distinctively rounded seat combines simple form with high comfort. The backrest, with its optimal tilt angle, supports a natural body position. The upholstery, made of high-quality synthetic leather in shades of black, is resistant and easy to clean. The modern design of the furniture emphasises the elegant character of the wash unit and perfectly complements the salon's décor. The set includes a complete set of fittings with a matte finish in shades of black, including a faucet, shower head, and matching hoses, providing a complete set of tools for work.

Detailed dimensions are given in the photo.

Bowl material: ceramic
Bowl colour: shades of black
Upholstery colour: shades of black
Base colour: shades of black
Fitting colour: shades of black
Upholstery material: synthetic leather

item.name: OCHO NAILS dual forms ballerina 120 pcs.
item.description:
The OCHO NAILS is a unique brand focusing on professional products for nail stylists. Its assortment includes hybrid nail polishes, nail gels, specialized lamps and nail care accessories. The OCHO NAILS products will meet the requirements of experienced users and those just beginning their adventure with manicures.

Perfect accessory for nail extensions

The transparent dual forms ballerina for nail extensions by Ocho Nails are a modern alternative to traditional templates. They allow you to quickly and precisely achieve the perfect ballerina shape, giving your nails symmetry and a perfect look. This is a great solution for both experienced stylists and people who are just starting their adventure with nail styling. 

Why choose Ocho Nails dual forms?

The ballerina-shaped dual forms are distinguished by their exceptional flexibility and durability, which allows for comfortable work without worrying about damaging them. The auxiliary lines make it easy to give your nails the selected length, and the transparent material ensures effective curing in a UV/LED lamp. The 12 sizes allow for a perfect fit of the dual form to the natural nail plate, which makes it easier to obtain a perfect effect. 

The pack contains 120 pieces in 12 different sizes. 

Directions for use:

1. Before starting the procedure, thoroughly disinfect your and the client's hands using an antiseptic liquid and prepare the workplace accordingly.
2. Use a file with the appropriate gradation to give the nails the desired shape, gently buff the plate with a polishing block, and if necessary, work on the cuticles.
3. Apply gel or acrylic gel to the concave part of the form.
4. Press the dual form onto the nail, ensuring it is positioned correctly.
5. Cure in a UV/LED lamp, adjusting the time to the product used.
6. Carefully remove the form, file the nail and finish the design with a selected hybrid nail polish or top coat.

item.name: CLARESA HARD&EASY BUILDER GEL CLEAR 12g
item.description:
Have you fallen in love with our iconic Soft&Easy line of gels? It's time to get to know its HARD counterpart!
HARD&EASY - a medium density hard builder gel that provides full control when working and guarantees exceptional styling durability.
HARD&EASY - thanks to its low level of elasticity, it is ideal for building a stable framework and extensions on a template or dual moulds. It is also an excellent choice for restorations and natural plate reinforcement.
Thanks to its balanced self-levelling properties and thixotropic liquid memory formula - it does not run off, does not flood cuticles and is ideal for the no-saw technique. In addition, its heatless formula significantly reduces the burning sensation in the lamp, ensuring comfort for even the most sensitive clients. The inhibitory layer present in the gel allows perfect blending of successive layers of products.
An opacity of up to 90% gives styling a beautiful, uniform surface and depth of colour
Requires the use of a priming base - we recommend the use of Bonding Base for Gel Claresa.

FEATURES:

  • Firm and stable - the gel provides a solid nail framework.
  • Self-leveling - lays well on the plate without flooding the cuticles. Control without compromise.
  • Thixotropic - the gel works exactly where you apply it.
  • Heatless formula - innovative formulation that minimises the burning sensation in the lamp. Comfortable even for sensitive clients.
  • Medium density - ideal for modelling both thin layers and strong constructions.
  • Indispensable for skeletonisation - especially recommended for structural work requiring precise moulding.
  • Versatile - extensions on templates, dual moulds as well as for classic nail restoration.
  • Saw-free technique - reduced working time.

COLOURS AVAILABLE:
- CLEAR - transparent, works great as a builder and levelling base for all hybrid polish colours.
- NATURAL - a natural, delicate nude colour, chosen to match your natural skin colour; great on its own, without the need for additional polish, up to 90% coverage!
- MILKY PINK - a delicate, bleached pink, works well on its own as a full manicure and as a base for a French or baby boomer, up to 90% coverage!
- GLAM PINK - pastel, delicate shade of pink with shimmering silver flecks, perfect on its own as a full manicure or as a base for further styling, 90% opacity!
- MILKY WHITE - a milky white, perfect for wedding manicures and everyday wear. Works well solo and with princess nails.
- PANNA COTTA - a very light pink that is sure to appeal to fans of cool tones, yet soft enough to suit all skin types. Perfect as a standalone style or for princess nails.
- LIGHT BEIGE - light, warm beige. Great for combining with fine tops and polishes and also solo, especially for those with a warm complexion.
- FRENCH PINK- light warm pink shade, perfect for french styling.

Directions: Prepare nail by applying a thin layer of base coat and cure according to the nail's instructions. Apply Hard gel with a brush and spread to desired length and shape. Cure under a UV LED lamp min. 60 sec. Rinse the nail with a cotton swab soaked in cleanser to remove the inhibitive layer. Optionally apply Top, following its instructions.

Ingredients: Bis-HEMA Polyneopentyl Glycol Adipate/Ipdi Copolymer, Isopropylidiphenyl Bisoxyhydroxypropyl Methacrylate, Bis-HEA Poly(1,4-Butanediol)-9/IPDI Copolymer , Trimethylolpropane Trimethacrylate, Hexanediol Dimethacrylate, Bis-HEA Polyglycol Adipate/IPDI Copolymer, Hydroxycyclohexyl Phenyl Ketone, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Isobornyl Methacrylate, Ethyl Trimethylbenzoyl Phenylphosphinate, Polyhydroxycarboxylic Acid Amides, PPG-3, Polyether Acrylate, Dipropylene Glycol Diacrylate, Polyester Acrylate, Hydroquinone, p-Hydroxyanisole +/- CI 74260, CI 74160, CI 12490, CI 15850, CI 73360, CI 60725, CI 15980, CI 15985, CI 77266, CI 42735, CI 77891, CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499, CI 19140, CI 77288, CI 45410, CI 77742, CI 77007, CI 77510, CI 42090, CI 47005, CI 77004, CI 16035, CI 61570, CI 77000

HARD&EASY - a medium density hard builder gel that provides full control when working and guarantees exceptional styling durability.
HARD&EASY - thanks to its low level of elasticity, it is ideal for building a stable framework and extensions on a template or dual moulds. It is also an excellent choice for restorations and natural plate reinforcement.
Thanks to its balanced self-levelling properties and thixotropic liquid memory formula - it does not run off, does not flood cuticles and is ideal for the no-saw technique. In addition, its heatless formula significantly reduces the burning sensation in the lamp, ensuring comfort for even the most sensitive clients. The inhibitory layer present in the gel allows perfect blending of successive layers of products.
An opacity of up to 90% gives styling a beautiful, uniform surface and depth of colour
Requires the use of a priming base - we recommend the use of Bonding Base for Gel Claresa.

FEATURES:

  • Firm and stable - the gel provides a solid nail framework.
  • Self-leveling - lays well on the plate without flooding the cuticles. Control without compromise.
  • Thixotropic - the gel works exactly where you apply it.
  • Heatless formula - innovative formulation that minimises the burning sensation in the lamp. Comfortable even for sensitive clients.
  • Medium density - ideal for modelling both thin layers and strong constructions.
  • Indispensable for skeletonisation - especially recommended for structural work requiring precise moulding.
  • Versatile - extensions on templates, dual moulds as well as for classic nail restoration.
  • Saw-free technique - reduced working time.

COLOURS AVAILABLE:
- CLEAR - transparent, works great as a builder and levelling base for all hybrid polish colours.
- NATURAL - a natural, delicate nude colour, chosen to match your natural skin colour; great on its own, without the need for additional polish, up to 90% coverage!
- MILKY PINK - a delicate, bleached pink, works well on its own as a full manicure and as a base for a French or baby boomer, up to 90% coverage!
- GLAM PINK - pastel, delicate shade of pink with shimmering silver flecks, perfect on its own as a full manicure or as a base for further styling, 90% opacity!
- MILKY WHITE - a milky white, perfect for wedding manicures and everyday wear. Works well solo and with princess nails.
- PANNA COTTA - a very light pink that is sure to appeal to fans of cool tones, yet soft enough to suit all skin types. Perfect as a standalone style or for princess nails.
- LIGHT BEIGE - light, warm beige. Great for combining with fine tops and polishes and also solo, especially for those with a warm complexion.
- FRENCH PINK- light warm pink shade, perfect for french styling.

Directions: Prepare nail by applying a thin layer of base coat and cure according to the nail's instructions. Apply Hard gel with a brush and spread to desired length and shape. Cure under a UV LED lamp min. 60 sec. Rinse the nail with a cotton swab soaked in cleanser to remove the inhibitive layer. Optionally apply Top, following its instructions.

Ingredients: Bis-HEMA Polyneopentyl Glycol Adipate/Ipdi Copolymer, Isopropylidiphenyl Bisoxyhydroxypropyl Methacrylate, Bis-HEA Poly(1,4-Butanediol)-9/IPDI Copolymer , Trimethylolpropane Trimethacrylate, Hexanediol Dimethacrylate, Bis-HEA Polyglycol Adipate/IPDI Copolymer, Hydroxycyclohexyl Phenyl Ketone, Silica Dimethyl Silylate, Isobornyl Methacrylate, Ethyl Trimethylbenzoyl Phenylphosphinate, Polyhydroxycarboxylic Acid Amides, PPG-3, Polyether Acrylate, Dipropylene Glycol Diacrylate, Polyester Acrylate, Hydroquinone, p-Hydroxyanisole +/- CI 74260, CI 74160, CI 12490, CI 15850, CI 73360, CI 60725, CI 15980, CI 15985, CI 77266, CI 42735, CI 77891, CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499, CI 19140, CI 77288, CI 45410, CI 77742, CI 77007, CI 77510, CI 42090, CI 47005, CI 77004, CI 16035, CI 61570, CI 77000

item.name: Microdermabrasion filters large cotton 40 pcs.
item.description:
Reliable device protection

The large cotton filters are an indispensable component for treatments with diamond microdermabrasion devices. They trap dead skin and debris, thus protecting the inside of the device from clogging the suction system. Regular filter replacement promotes efficient, trouble-free operation of the equipment and maintains the high effectiveness of the treatments.

Cleanliness and hygiene during every treatment

The filters are made of a dense, durable cotton that effectively captures even the smallest impurities. Disposable and hygienic - replace them after each use to ensure safety and a professional standard of work.

With a diameter of 16 mm, the filters can be used in many microdermabrasion devices on the market.
40 pieces of large filters included.

item.name: GLOW eyelash treatment lamp black
item.description:
The GLOW brand products are professional lighting that improves the performance of services both in beauty salons and medical offices. It offers a wide selection of specialist lamps, including UV/LED and treatment lamps, necessary for precise work.

Shadowless cosmetic lamp

The GLOW eyelash treatment lamp with a unique arc-shaped head with adjustable angles provides excellent lighting during treatments requiring precision. It is ideal for all specialist practices, where the right light can significantly affect the quality of services performed. Perfect for eyelash extensions or thickening, tattoos, beauty treatments or make-up.

Movable, arched head

The characteristic shape of the lamp head is not only a modern design, but above all a functional solution. The wide, arched panel, divided into two parts filled with 308 LEDs, provides even, shadowless lighting of the treatment area, increasing work comfort. It is also perfect for photographing the effects of treatments, precisely exposing them. The surface of the panel effectively disperses light, minimising the glare effect. Thanks to the ability to adjust the colour and intensity of light, the lamp provides excellent reproduction of colours seen and minimises eye fatigue, even during prolonged use. Additionally, the rotating head and the widely adjustable frame allow the angle of light to be precisely adjusted. What's more, both panels can be adjusted independently within a range of 90 degrees, which provides even greater freedom in adapting the lighting to individual needs.

Wide range of adjustment

The tripod can be easily adjusted in the range of 155-195 cm using a locking screw located on the arm. This allows for precise adjustment of the head position to the individual needs of the user and various types of cosmetic chairs, beds and treatment tables, ensuring optimal lighting of the work area. The colour and intensity of light can be adjusted using two remote controls – one, located on the cable is always at hand, and the other allows remote control of settings. Additionally, thanks to the built-in magnet, it can be conveniently attached in a selected place.

Adjustment to individual needs

The adjustment option includes three levels of colour temperature (3000-6000 K) and seven levels of light intensity, allowing the lighting to be precisely tailored to individual needs. The full mobility of the head and the rotating arm of the tripod allow the position of the lamp to be precisely adjusted.  However, the best stability is achieved by setting it along the base. Additional stability is guaranteed by a lockable hinge, which allows the angle of the lamp to be precisely adjusted. 

Convenience of sharing work effects

The set includes a phone holder, which allows you to stably and aesthetically document the effects of your work. It also makes it easier to record videos while performing services, so that you can later share the footage on social media. The holder can be placed at different angles to achieve interesting and varied shots. The wide adjustment range of the clamp makes it suitable for many phone models.

Modern and functional design

The lamp is distinguished by its elegant, minimalist design, which perfectly matches the interiors of beauty salons, aesthetic medicine offices and spaces for professional eyelash and nail styling. The slim, adjustable stand combined with the stable base ensure comfort of use and aesthetic that do not overwhelm the space. The subtle, black finish gives it a modern feel.

Detailed dimensions are given in the photo.
Note. Before use, carefully read the instructions and assemble the product correctly.

Included: lamp, stand elements, base, phone holder, wireless remote control, power supply and power cable, instructions.

Data:
Input voltage: 220-240 V
Power: 31 W
Light colour: 3000-6000 K
CRI: RA > 90
Luminous flux: 4000 LM
Frame colour: shades of black
Warranty: 12 months

item.name: Mondial DETRISAN spray for disinfection of non-invasive devices
item.description:
DETRISAN – Fast and Effective Disinfection for Beauty Salons and Medical Facilities

A professional disinfectant for surfaces and equipment used in beauty salons, podiatry clinics, tattoo studios, and medical facilities. Perfect for quick disinfection of treatment chairs, beds, countertops, devices, and non-invasive tools. DETRISAN acts quickly, without causing corrosion or discoloration. It contains no dyes and leaves a pleasant scent.

DETRISAN effectively eliminates a broad spectrum of microorganisms:

    Bacteria: Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Enterococcus hirae, Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii

    Fungi: Candida albicans

    Enveloped viruses: HIV, HBV, HCV

Safe and convenient to use:

    Surface-safe – does not cause corrosion or staining

    Ready to use – no dilution required

    Fast action – effective in as little as 5 minutes

Composition (per 100 g of product):

0.05 g didecyldimethylammonium chloride,
0.10 g benzalkonium chloride,
0.20 g chlorhexidine gluconate,
inert ingredients and water to 100 g

Directions for use:

    Ensure the surface is suitable for disinfection before applying

    Apply generously using a spray or cloth, leave for at least 5 minutes, then wipe with a clean cloth and allow to air dry

    Exercise caution when disinfecting electrical devices – follow manufacturer guidelines

Safety precautions:

    Avoid contact with eyes – in case of contact, rinse thoroughly with water

    Wear protective gloves

    Do not release into the environment

    Store tightly closed, away from heat and light sources, at room temperature

For professional use only.

item.name: BALANCE aluminium folding massage table 2 segment cream
item.description:
BALANCE is a brand created for those who seek harmony – in movement, daily activity and moments of relaxation. Its products support both yoga practice, fitness training and specialist work of physiotherapists. They combine functionality with aesthetics, offering solutions tailored to the needs of active people – suitable for the home, the office and the training room.

Comfortable massage table essential in physiotherapy

The BALANCE folding aluminium massage table is a practical and versatile solution, designed for the daily work of massage therapists, physiotherapists and other professionals. The two-segment construction ensures stability and comfort for both the person performing the treatment and the patient. Thanks to its compact dimensions, light weight and the included bag, it is also perfect for mobile work – allowing for quick and convenient folding and carrying.

Simple height adjustment mechanism

The height of the table can be adjusted to the height and individual needs of the person performing the treatment using a telescopic adjustment from 58 to 80 cm with a locking mechanism. Each of the table's aluminum legs consists of two tubes that can be freely moved relative to each other after being unlocked. The Fast Lock mechanism holds the elements in the selected position once the lock is placed in the appropriate hole. Additionally, the frame structure is stabilized with metal cables, which makes the massage table solid and perfect for a wide range of services.

Comfort of treatments performed on the back

To ensure maximum comfort, the person using the table can rest their head on the ergonomic headrest, which is included in the set. This element is easy to adjust – it allows the angle to be adjusted in two planes, which makes it possible to precisely adjust its position to the user's needs and the nature of the treatment being performed. For supine therapy, the headrest can be removed, using a special hole in the tabletop instead. When not in use, the hole can be covered with the included plug, restoring the surface to an aesthetic and uniform appearance.

Ergonomic support for the arms

Regardless of the type of treatment performed or the position adopted by the patient, the correct positioning of the hands is essential – ensuring relaxation without hindering the therapist's work. This model is equipped with easy-to-install armrests and an additional shelf under the arms, irreplaceable when the patient is positioned on the abdomen. These solutions increase the functionality of the table and guarantee high comfort for the person receiving treatment.

Convenient solutions for mobile services

The lightweight construction makes it easy to carry, making the table an ideal choice for mobile work. The BALANCE model folds and unfolds quickly and effortlessly, and takes up little space when folded. There are straps under the table top to secure accessories for transport, allow the table to be conveniently repositioned at any time. The set also includes a dedicated transport bag with a shoulder strap and a handle – it protects the table from dirt and damage, ensuring comfortable movement.

Thoughtful choice for years

The BALANCE massage table has been designed with comfort and durability in mind.  Soft imitation leather upholstery and a foam filling with optimum firmness ensure comfort during treatments. The materials are resistant to moisture, easy to clean and durable, which makes the table perfect for everyday work. The aluminum legs increase the stability of the structure, and thanks to its resistance to moisture, the table can also be safely used in places such as fitness clubs or locker rooms.

The colour of the product in the photo may differ from the actual colour due to monitor settings and lighting conditions. The exact dimensions are given in the photo.
The set includes: massage table, armrests, adjustable headrest, front shelf for arms, plug, carrying bag.

Details:
Upholstery material: imitation leather
Filling: foam
Frame material: aluminum
Upholstery color: shades of cream

item.name: Saeyang nail drill machine Marathon K35 mini pink + H200
item.description:
The Saeyang brand offers high-quality tools useful when performing professional manicure and pedicure treatments. The Saeyang products, valued among cosmetologists, are characterized by excellent workmanship, precision and the use of innovative solutions.

Professional device for manicure and pedicure treatments

The high-class Saeyang Marathon K35 mini nail drill is a practical device that allows for precise preparation of nails and cuticles, preparing them for further treatments. Using the device makes it much easier to remove the remains of previous nail styling. The well-balanced head, compact dimensions, well-thought-out functionalities and a multitude of available options make the nail drill perfect for professional use, especially for mobile services.

Practical head H200

The functional, precise head fits perfectly in the hand, which guarantees high working comfort. It is equipped with an easy-to-use Twist-Lock system, which allows for quick and smooth replacement of bits. This makes working with the device exceptionally easy and intuitive, which will also be appreciated by more demanding users. The element is properly balanced and ergonomically profiled, and additionally, head vibrations have been reduced, so that even many hours of work with the nail drill machine do not tire the hand excessively.

Digital display with clear control panel

The nail drill is equipped with a clear control panel with a digital display, which plays a key role in monitoring and controlling the operation of the device. The screen informs about the rotational speed at which the unit’s head is currently operating to ensure precise and safe operation of the nail drill machine. The speed can be adjusted using a knob up to 30 000 revolutions per minute, allowing for customization and therefore and thus comfortably perform a wide range of treatments. System of smooth rotational direction change with a built-in pause ensures safe and comfortable switching between both working directions. Additionally, the control diode lights up in green or red, making it easier to recognize the direction of operation of the nail drill machine. The control panel also has a pause function, which allows the user to stop the device, giving greater control over the process. The solutions used make the operation of the nail drill intuitive and very effective.

Precise functionalities for comfort of use

The accessories included in the set ensure not only safety, but also comfort of use. During work, the head can be safely placed on the dedicated silicone stand included in the set. The place for nail drill bits on the housing allows you to prepare the necessary tools to have them at hand while working. The overload protection with LED warning signal protects the motor from overheating, which ensures greater operational safety and protects against damage to the device.

Modern, compact device

The small Saeyang Marathon K35 mini nail drill machine is a perfect example of combining functionality with aesthetics. The aesthetically pleasing, futuristic casing in shades of white and pink will fit perfectly into any interior and will work well even in limited space. Additionally, the nail drill is equipped with rubberised feet that not only ensure stability, but also protect the surface on which it is placed against possible damage. With these features this device not only perfectly fulfills its functions, but also constitutes an elegant element of interior design, emphasizing the modern character of any room.

The set includes: nail drill base, head, power supply, silicone headstand, instructions.

Head with Twist-Lock mechanism

Matt finish and modern aesthetics

The NGHIA Export C-111 professional nail clippers are made of high-quality carbon steel, making them practical and durable. They are perfect for manicures and pedicures, especially for cutting cuticles. The pliers are suitable for disinfection at low temperatures.

Solutions for high working comfort

A single spring connects the arms of the clippers, ensuring feel and precision cutting. The careful design of the spring allows for comfortable work. - Always store in a horizontal position.

item.name: Syis vitamin cocktail cream 150 ml
item.description:
Vitamin cocktail cream

SYIS Vitamin Cocktail light cream with a nourishing formula has been created for daily regeneration and care of the skin of the face, neck and décolleté. It works well in both professional and home care, especially for skin in need of intensive hydration, smoothing and brightening.

Nourishes and brightens the skin every day

A complex of vitamins A, C and E supports the regenerative processes and has an antioxidant and brightening effect. Shea butter and sweet almond oil intensively nourish and firm the skin, while panthenol soothes irritation.

Smooth, moisturised and radiant skin

Thanks to its light texture, the cream is quickly absorbed without leaving a greasy film. Regular use helps to maintain optimum hydration levels and keep skin looking healthy.

Proven efficacy

The product is safe for the skin and dermatologically tested. Effectiveness was confirmed in a natural application test - 100% of participants confirmed skin care, intensive nourishment and hydration, support for skin regeneration, firming and maintenance of a healthy complexion, as well as smoothing and brightening of the skin. In addition, up to 80% of the survey participants noted the soothing of irritation.

Active ingredients:

Ascorbic Acid - Vitamin C

A powerful antioxidant that promotes collagen production, brightens the complexion and evens out skin tone.

Retinyl Palmitate - vitamin A

Promotes epidermal regeneration and the reduction of fine lines, improving skin elasticity.

Tocopheryl Acetate, Tocopherol - vitamin E

Natural antioxidant, protects cells from free radicals and delays the ageing process.

Butyrospermum Parkii Butter - shea butter

Nourishes and strengthens the skin's lipid barrier for softness and smoothness.

Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil - sweet almond oil

Moisturises and soothes, increases the elasticity of the skin, restoring its healthy appearance.

Panthenol - panthenol

Soothes irritation, promotes the regeneration process and protects against moisture loss.

Warning. The product contains vitamin A. Please take into account its daily intake before use.

Directions for use:

Apply a small amount of cream to cleansed skin on face, neck and décolleté. Gently massage in until absorbed. Apply morning and evening or according to individual skin needs.

Capacity: 150 ml

Composition (INCI): Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Isopropyl Myristate, Glyceryl Stearate, Glyceryl Stearate Citrate, Parfum, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Phenoxyethanol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil, Panthenol, Olus Oil, Ascorbic Acid, Retinyl Palmitate, Tocopherol, Hydroxyethyl Acrylate/Sodium Acryloyldimethyl Taurate Copolymer, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, Ethylhexylglycerin, Triethanolamine, Sorbitan Isostearate, Polysorbate 60, Citronellol, Limonene, Hexyl Cinnamal, Geraniol, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Citral, Isoeugenol, Hexamethylindanopyran.

SYIS is a Polish brand of professional cosmetics created for effective care. It is distinguished by the high quality of its active ingredients, which respond to the needs of modern, conscious clients.

item.name: Syis cream mask for couperose skin 250 ml
item.description:
Cream mask for vascular skin

SYIS professional cream mask for vascular skin has been developed for delicate, sensitive skin prone to redness and irritation. Ideal for both professional and home care, it promotes regeneration, soothes and strengthens the skin.

Strengthens and soothes sensitive skin

The mask formula combines the effects of natural plant extracts with peptide complexes and vitamin E. Extracts of arnica montana, chamomile and horse chestnut reduce the appearance of capillaries and help reduce redness. Avocado oil, panthenol and bisabolol intensively nourish and soothe the skin, promoting regeneration and protection against external factors. A peptide complex promotes collagen and elastin production, helping to maintain skin firmness and elasticity.

Skin regenerated, soothed and radiant

Thanks to its creamy texture, the mask wraps the skin in a gentle protective layer, having a nurturing effect. Regular application promotes skin regeneration and strengthens its structure.

Proven efficacy

The product is safe for the skin and dermatologically tested. Its effectiveness was confirmed in an application test conducted under natural conditions - 100% of participants confirmed a nurturing, strengthening and soothing effect on the skin, while 93% noticed a firming effect.

Active ingredients:

Bisabolol

A natural ingredient of plant origin with a strong soothing effect. Soothes the skin, promotes regeneration and protects against irritation.

Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract

Soothes and has a strengthening effect, improving the condition of sensitive skin.

Arnica Montana Flower Extract

Strengthens skin structure, reduces redness and promotes regeneration.

Aesculus Hippocastanum Flower Extract - horse chestnut extract

Improves skin elasticity and firmness, has a strengthening and protective effect.

Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7 and Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1 peptides

Modern anti-ageing complexes that stimulate collagen and elastin synthesis. Firms the skin and promotes repair processes.

Persea Gratissima Oil - avocado oil

Source of vitamins A, D and E and unsaturated fatty acids. Nourishes, softens and strengthens the skin, restoring its elasticity.

Lactic Acid

Gently exfoliates dead skin cells, improves hydration and regulates skin pH.

Tocopheryl Acetate - Vitamin E

Powerful antioxidant that protects cells from free radicals. Promotes regeneration and slows down the ageing process.

Panthenol - panthenol

Soothes irritation and promotes healing, leaving the skin feeling soothed and soft.

Directions for use:

Apply an even, thin layer of mask to cleansed facial skin, avoiding the eye and lip areas. Leave on for 10-15 minutes, then wash off with lukewarm water. Use 1-2 times a week or according to individual skin needs.

Capacity: 250 ml.

Ingredients (INCI): Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Glycerin, Sodium Polyacrylate, Ethylhexyl Cocoate, Persea Gratissima Oil, Phenoxyethanol, Bisabolol, Chamomilla Recutita Flower Extract, Arnica Montana Flower Extract, Aesculus Hippocastanum Flower Extract, Palmitoyl Tetrapeptide-7, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Tocopheryl Acetate, Panthenol, Lactic Acid, Sodium Lactate, Sodium Phytate, Butylene Glycol, PPG-3 Benzyl Ether Myristate, Polysorbate 20, Ethylhexylglycerin, Carbomer, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum, Tetramethyl Acetyl Acetahydronaphthalenes, Hexamethylindanopyran, Limonene, Vanillin.

item.name: Syis normalising cream mask 250 ml
item.description:
Normalizing cream mask

SYIS professional normalising cream mask was developed for oily, combination and problematic skin. It helps improve skin condition, absorbs excess sebum and promotes epidermal regeneration. Ideal for both professional and home care - for skin in need of cleansing, soothing and protection.

Skin balance, freshness and smoothness

The mask's formula based on white clay (kaolin) absorbs excess sebum and has a soothing effect without drying out the skin. Extracts of horse chestnut, sabal palm, purple coneflower and pineapple nourish and regenerate the skin, improving its overall condition. Azelaic and salicylic acids help to reduce imperfections and smooth the skin, providing the complexion with comfort and a healthy appearance.

Comprehensive skin care

The richness of the vegetable oils - sweet almond, argan and sesame - combined with vitamin E and panthenol provides the skin with optimum nourishment and regeneration, without astringency. Regular use of the mask supports the skin's normalisation process, improving its overall condition.

Proven efficacy

The product is safe for the skin and dermatologically tested. Effectiveness was confirmed in an application test conducted under natural conditions - 100% of participants confirmed improved skin condition, smoothing, nourishing, regenerating and protecting effect on the skin and ensuring its comfort and healthy appearance. In addition, 93% of those surveyed noted the absorption of excess sebum and a soothing effect on the skin, while 86% confirmed a gently cleansing and imperfection-reducing effect.

Active ingredients:

Kaolin - white clay

Natural mineral with purifying and sebum-absorbing properties. Gently mattifies, soothes and promotes skin regeneration.

Serenoa Serrulata Fruit Extract - Sabal palm extract.

Regulates sebum secretion, supports the fight against imperfections and improves the condition of oily and acne-prone skin.

Echinacea Purpurea Root Extract

Has a soothing effect, strengthens the skin and supports its natural defence mechanisms.

Ananas Sativus Fruit Extract - pineapple extract

Source of bromelain enzymes that gently exfoliate and smooth the epidermis, giving the complexion a fresh look.

Aesculus Hippocastanum Flower Extract - horse chestnut extract

Improves skin firmness and elasticity, has a strengthening and regenerative effect.

Azelaic Acid

Supports the reduction of imperfections, has an anti-inflammatory and smoothing effect.

Salicylic Acid

Gently exfoliates dead skin cells and promotes improvement in skin texture.

Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil

Nourishes, regenerates and strengthens the skin's lipid barrier.

Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis Oil - sweet almond oil

Softens, smoothens and soothes irritation.

Sesamum Indicum Seed Oil

Rich in antioxidants, promotes regeneration and protects against moisture loss.

Panthenol - panthenol

Soothes irritation, accelerates regeneration and improves skin elasticity.

Tocopherol - vitamin E

Protects against oxidative stress, supports repair processes and gives the complexion a healthy glow.

Directions for use:

The iWAX brand aims to provide multifunctional tools for cosmetic wax and paraffin treatments, such as state-of-the-art hair removal wax heaters. It focuses on interesting design, product versatility and ease of use, making the iWAX range aimed at both professional and home use.

Universal can and hard wax warmer

The iWax wax warmer enables wax to be properly and quickly prepared for depilation. Designed for 500 ml tins and hard waxes, it provides the convenience and freedom to choose the form of epilation. The high-quality plastic housing is easy to clean and the transparent lid allows you to monitor the melting process at all times.

Precise temperature and running time adjustment

The temperature and running time are set using intuitive function buttons, allowing you to precisely adjust the settings to the specific treatment and type of wax used. The temperature control range from 35°C to 125°Callows you to precisely adjust the heating intensity to the type of wax and the specific treatment. The device is suitable for both professional work and everyday salon use.

Modern display and practical facilities

The easy-to-read display shows all parameters in real time, making it easy to monitor settings and use the device. The heater switches on at the press of a single touch button, accompanied by a short beep. Pressing again switches the unit off, generating three confirmation beeps. The beep also occurs whenever the settings are changed, providing full control over the operation of the equipment. The aluminium container with a comfortable handle supports the maintenance of the appliance, increasing the comfort of daily use.

Practical solutions

The minimalist, modern form inspired by the shape of an apple gives the device a unique character, and the compact dimensions make it look good in any beauty salon. The warmer is made of durable plastic in elegant shades of black, which is resistant and easy to clean. The transparent lid makes it possible to monitor the melting process of the wax, and the small openings placed in the lid act as ventilation, protecting the device from overheating. The stable construction and non-slip feet ensure a secure positioning, ensuring safety and comfort during use.

How to clean the wax warmer?

1) Do not use solvents or strong detergents.
2) Always unplug the unit before cleaning.
3) Do not immerse the unit in water.
4) Do not use sharp tools to remove residues.
5. use a dedicated wax residue remover for cleaning.

Included: heater, power cord, wax container with handle, lid.

Technical data:
Power: 100 W
Capacity: 500 ml
Temperature control: 35-125°C
Time control: 1-99 min
Input voltage: 220-240 V
Power cord length: 140 cm
Dimensions: 20.2 x 20.2 x 18.8 cm

item.name: Kessner JET2 professional hair dryer 2200W
item.description:
The Kessner brand specialises in providing compact hair styling appliances, with an emphasis on affordability and customer satisfaction. The brand's range includes practical appliances such as hair dryers, straighteners and clippers.

Professional hair dryer with high-speed brushless motor

The Kessner JET2 hair dryer is a state-of-the-art device designed for stylists who want maximum performance, lightness and reliability. The dryer has been designed to enable comfortable and long-lasting work in salon and home conditions.

Fast drying and precise styling

The long-life motor ensures stable operation, high resistance to overheating and reliability for years. A speed of 120,000 rpm guarantees fast drying and effective styling, while operating extremely quietly at 65 dB. Power of up to 2,200 watts and an airflow of up to 28.5 m/s allow even extremely thick and long hair to be dried quickly.

Temperature and airflow control

The three-stage temperature control and three fan speeds allow you to precisely adjust the parameters for different hair types. The cold air button allows you to fix your hairstyle, close the cuticles and give your hair a natural shine. The built-in overheat protection system ensures safe use of the device.

Functionality and accessories

The set includes three heat-resistant tips, which are easy to install with a practical locking system. The set includes two concentrators with widths of 65mm and 75mm, allowing you to precisely direct the airflow, and a diffuser, which is perfect for styling curls and adding volume to your hair. The removable dust filter can be cleaned with water or a special brush, significantly extending the life of the device.

Comfort and ergonomics

The hairdryer weighs just 320g including the cable, making it extremely comfortable to use even during prolonged use. The lightweight construction made of durable PA plastic, which is resistant to heat and falls, guarantees not only a long life of the device, but also safety during everyday use in the salon or at home. The ergonomic shape makes it even easier to manoeuvre the dryer and style hair with precision.

Included: hair dryer, 2 concentrators (65 mm, 75 mm), diffuser.

Technical data:
Colour: shades of grey
Motor speed: 120,000 rpm
Airflow: up to 28.5 m/s
Temperature adjustment: three-stage
Supply air control: three-stage
Cold air button
Noise level: 65 dB
Material: Heat-resistant, damage-resistant PA plastic
Power: 2200 W
Voltage: 220-240 V
Frequency: ~50 Hz
Guarantee: 12 months

Cable length: 320 cm

The OCHO is a unique brand focusing on professional products for nail stylists. Its assortment includes hybrid nail polishes, nail gels, specialized lamps and nail care accessories. Professional brush for the beauty industry

Soft bristles and ergonomic design

The fluffy head enables fine dirt to be gently removed from countertops, tools or accessories. The slim handle sits well in the hand and the lightweight design facilitates precise manoeuvring. Versatile brush

item.name: Saeyang Marathon 103 head stand
item.description:
The Saeyang brand offers high-quality tools for professional manicure and pedicure treatments. Saeyang products, highly regarded among cosmetologists, are characterised by excellent workmanship, precision and the use of innovative solutions.

Professional handpiece holder

The Saeyang Marathon 103 head stand is a professional solution for prosthetic laboratories and dental laboratories, where maximum precision is required. It allows precise guidance of the milling machine head, ensuring stability and comfort when working on models and components.

Robust design for precision work

The Marathon 103 combines a solid, stable construction with precise arm and model table settings, making it ideal for repetitive milling machine work and prosthetic corrections. item.name: Depilflax 100 flexible low melting point wax Ultraflex mauve with titanium dioxide 600g
item.description:
Depilflax is a brand specializing in hair removal products, offering a wide range of waxes pre- and post-treatment cosmetics which meet the high expectations of professionals. The innovative formulas are based on natural ingredients, emphasizing the brand's concern for the skin and the environment.

Professional hair removal product

Vegan wax in beads Depilflax Ultraflex Mauve is a product suitable for all skin types, especially to delicate and sensitive skin. It provides high comfort and safety of the depilation procedure. Perfect choice for professional beauty salons and people who value efficiency and comfort during depilation. Specially selected active substances guarantee optimal and gentle depilation. Using this type of wax makes the treatments even more effective and less painful. The product is based on natural ingredients and carefully selected active substances ensure optimal and gentle depilation.

Hard wax for special tasks 

High elasticity facilitates application in thin layers, which shortens the treatment time. The form of beads helps to measure necessary amount of product and ensures precise and effective depilation. The low melting level of the wax causes it to quickly dissolve and be ready for use, which speeds up the depilation process. Using this type of wax makes depilation even more effective and gentle. Thanks to its special formula, the wax perfectly catches hair, regardless of the direction of their growth and allows easy removal. It can be used to removing body and facial hair.

How to use

• Place the wax in the heater and heat on the maximum temperature until the wax melts completely,
• Reduce the temperature to medium and wait until wax reaches the application temperature (about 65-70°C),
• Thoroughly clean and dry the skin in the treatment area,
• Apply the wax with a spatula, making sure the edges are thin to increase efficiency,
• Let the wax sit for a few seconds until it begins to harden. Stretch the skin and quickly remove the wax by pulling firmly in the opposite direction to the application.

Ingredients: hydrogenated polydicyclopentadiene paraffin, ethylene vinyl acetate copolymer, microcrystalline wax, liquid paraffin, PEG-3 Dioleate, synthetic fluorophlogopite, vinylpyrrole don-vinyl acetate copolymer, titanium dioxide, dyes, tin oxide.
Weight: 600 g
Manufacturer: MayStar

item.name: Gabbiano Elias barber chair red
item.description:
Gabbiano is a luxury brand of hairdressing equipment and furniture, distinguished by reliability, quality, aesthetics of workmanship, and high comfort of use. It offers a wide selection of functional salon equipment such as chairs, washers, and infrazones.

Stylish barber chair

The Gabbiano Elias barber chair stands out with its elegant stitching and functional design, created with ergonomic work in mind. Equipped with an efficient hydraulic lift, adjustable backrest and footrest, it allows for easy adjustment of the position to suit the type of treatment being performed. Extensive adjustment options significantly increase the comfort of services for both the customer and the barber.

Extensive adjustment options

The durable hydraulic lift allows for easy adjustment of the seat height in the range of 56-96 cm, even while the client is sitting in the chair. This guarantees ergonomic work and easy adjustment of the seat level to the height of the client and the person performing the treatment. The model is equipped with a reclining backrest and an adjustable footrest, which allows the customer to be placed in a comfortable, semi-reclining position and provides better access during selected services. In addition, the headrest, which can be extended by 20 cm, guarantees stable and comfortable head support, tailored to individual needs.

Amenities for comfortable work

The comfortable seat ensures the client's comfort during a variety of services. The profiled backrest promotes a stable, comfortable position and provides solid back support, which is particularly important for longer treatments. The full rotation mechanism increases freedom of movement and translates into greater work efficiency. Upholstered armrests allow for correct shoulder positioning, preventing the client from raising their shoulders and slouching, which makes it much easier for the barber to perform precise treatments.

Distinctive style and functionality

The stable base provides secure support and high comfort of use. The seat is filled with deformation-resistant foam and upholstered with semi-matt synthetic leather, guaranteeing durability and comfort for a long time. The materials are distinguished by their resistance to moisture and ease of cleaning. The burgundy upholstery combined with metal chrome elements and a decorative footrest give the chair a distinctive, classic character. Vertical stitching emphasises the vintage style, which fits perfectly into the atmosphere of professional barbershops. Carefully refined details give the whole a representative look, and the functional design promotes comfortable and effective work.

Detailed dimensions are provided in the photo. The colour of the product in the photo may differ from the actual colour due to monitor settings and lighting conditions.
The set includes: seat, cylinder with base, headrest.

Base: round

item.name: Azzurro Lux cosmetic chair 3m white
item.description:
The Azzurro brand offers high quality cosmetic armchairs and couches, as well as multifunctional devices of the combi type. Professional equipment is used, among others, in beauty salons, podological surgeries, massage studios or physiotherapy.

Comfort and functionality in one

The Azzurro Lux electric cosmetic chair is equipped with 3 actuators controlled by a wired remote control, which enables smooth and precise adjustment of individual elements. It stands out for its stability and versatility of use, making it ideal for beauty, podiatry and aesthetic medicine surgeries. Intuitive operation and a wide range of adjustments make it easy to adapt the chair to the needs of both the client and the practitioner.

Free adjustment by remote control

Convenient control with a wired remote control allows for precise adjustment of the chair in three planes: height adjustment, backrest angle and footrest setting. This range of adjustment makes it possible to tailor the position to the type of treatment being performed - in terms of both client comfort and specialist ergonomics. For ease of use, the remote control can be hooked onto handles located on both sides of the seat.

Functionality to facilitate treatments

The seat height is adjustable from 65 cm to 84 cm, allowing the position to be comfortably adjusted to the height of both the client and the treatment practitioner. When fully extended, the chair reaches a length of over 2 metres, providing comfortable support for the body - even during treatments requiring a lying position. Thanks to such parameters, the equipment is suitable for a variety of treatments, both care and specialised, guaranteeing ergonomic work and a high standard of service.

Comfortable seat and practical armrests

The wide seat ensures comfort even during lengthy treatments. The easily removable and movable armrests, which can be rotated 180°, make it easy for the client to sit on the chair and provide unhindered access for the practitioner. The chair also features an adjustable headrest, which guarantees stable head support and additional comfort, especially for taller clients.

Facial and body treatment facilities

The chair is ideal for cosmetic and beauty treatments, as well as for physiotherapy or tattoo studios. The extendable headrest allows the chair to be adjusted to the client's height, providing stable support for the head during treatments. The ability to unfold the chair into a recliner position significantly expands its range of applications. Another advantage is the hole in the headrest, discreetly concealed with a cap, which increases comfort when lying down - especially during back treatments. Thoughtful design solutions translate into user comfort and specialist ergonomics .

Style and durability

item.name: Momo J-404 built-in dust absorber
item.description:
Momo is a manufacturer of excellent accessories useful for manicures, including dust absorbers and practical supports. The products are perfect for everyday use. A wide selection of models and practical solutions will satisfy even the most demanding users.

An indispensable piece of equipment for nail styling

The Momo J-404 built-in dust absorber is the perfect answer to the needs of nail stylists, guaranteeing effective protection of the respiratory tract of employees and customers against dust generated during services. The high power of the device and the efficient filter ensure comfortable working conditions and adequate support during manicure and pedicure treatments.

Proven solutions for comfortable working

During treatments performed with a nail drill, a large amount of dust is released into the air. In such conditions, a powerful absorber becomes an element of equipment that significantly improves the quality and comfort of work by ensuring effective air purification. It raises the hygiene standard of the salon, increases the comfort of the stylist and provides a safer environment for customers, especially when a large number of services are performed.

Solutions for functionality

The possibility of installing an absorber in the desk top is an excellent solution that improves both the aesthetics and functionality of the workplace. This makes it much easier to maintain high hygiene standards in the nail salon. The extractor with an elegant cover looks aesthetically pleasing and does not take up valuable desk space, making it much easier to organise the workstation. Its location significantly improves work ergonomics.

Service safety thanks to an efficient filter

The model uses a cassette filter that effectively traps even the smallest dust particles, ensuring clean air in the workplace. The filtered air is discharged through precisely positioned ventilation openings, which supports the efficiency of the device. The large absorption surface allows you to hold both hands over the device at the same time, and thanks to the high efficiency of the absorber, contaminants are effectively removed directly into the filter. Remember to clean and replace the filter regularly to extend the life of the device and protect it from overheating.

Precise power control and Click system

The absorber is equipped with a knob for stepless power adjustment, which allows you to adjust the intensity of the device to the needs of the stylist and the type of treatment performed. In addition, the Click system prevents the knob from being loosened – a characteristic click confirms the correct setting, protecting the motor from overload and extending the life of the device.

Modern, minimalist design

This model combines functionality and modern style. The simple, well-thought-out design and metal cover with an interesting pattern give the device a futuristic character that attracts customers' attention and distinguishes the salon from the competition. The absorber looks extremely elegant, yet is durable, resistant and easy to keep clean. The minimalist form not only fits in with modern interiors, but also increases the ergonomics of the workstation, making the device a practical piece of equipment for any nail salon.

Before use, please read the instructions carefully – assembly instructions.
The set includes: absorber, cassette filter, brush, power supply.

item.name: Glow manicure treatment lamp L05 bent for tabletop white
item.description:
GLOW products are professional lighting solutions that improve the performance of services in both beauty salons and medical clinics. The range includes a wide selection of specialist lamps, including UV and treatment lamps, which are essential for precision work.

Ideal lighting for precise procedures

The practical Glow L05 treatment lamp, which can be mounted on a tabletop, is equipped with a convertible head and an adjustable frame, ensuring precise and even lighting during work. It is perfect for procedures requiring high accuracy and is used in beauty salons, nail and eyelash styling, make-up, skincare and tattooing.

Practical adjustable head

A distinctive feature of the lamp is its head with bent arms that move horizontally within a range of 215°, combining modern, intriguing design with high functionality. The profile filled with LED tape ensures even, shadow-free illumination of the treatment area, increasing the comfort of performing services and facilitating the adjustment of settings to individual needs. The structural surface of the panel effectively diffuses the light, so that the lamp does not dazzle the eyes. In addition, the rotating head with a wide range of movement allows for precise lighting adjustment according to the user's preferences and the nature of the service being performed.

Wide range of customisation options

The movable elements of the stand and lamp head provide great freedom in setting up the lighting of the workplace, depending on the type of procedure being performed. The position of the stand can be easily adjusted thanks to four joints on the arm and a 360° rotating base. These solutions allow the head to be precisely adjusted to the individual needs of the user, ensuring optimal illumination of the working area and a high level of working comfort.

Colour and intensity adjustment

The ability to adjust the colour and intensity of the light ensures perfect reproduction of the colours seen, which reduces eye fatigue during long periods of work. The colour and intensity of the light can be gradually adjusted using the touch panel located on the head. The adjustment includes five colour temperature levels (from cool to neutral to warm) and five light intensity levels. By holding down the buttons for a longer period of time, it is also possible to adjust the light continuously, which gives you great flexibility in adjusting the lighting to your individual needs. The lamp is also equipped with a light sensor that automatically adjusts the light intensity to the brightness of the surroundings, further enhancing the comfort of work.

Modern design and functionality

The slim, geometric form of the lamp attracts attention with its modern yet timeless appearance. The white colour scheme combined with a matte finish gives the design an elegant, professional character that fits perfectly into the minimalist interiors of beauty salons. Mounting to the tabletop is possible thanks to a vice-like clamp with a maximum opening of 6.3 cm, which is suitable for most tabletops. The whole creates a coherent, aesthetic piece of equipment that combines high functionality with a refined design.

item.name: OCHO mini UV LED lamp
item.description:
OCHO is a unique brand focusing on professional products for nail stylists. Its range includes hybrid varnishes, gels, specialised lamps and nail care accessories. OCHO products will meet the requirements of both experienced users and those who are just starting their adventure with manicure.

Practical UV lamp

The Ocho mini UV LED lamp is a handy device designed for curing UV/LED products. Its mobile design allows for quick and convenient use of the lamp anywhere, both in the salon and when working outside of it. It works well for the initial polymerisation of gels, builder gels and UV/LED hybrid polishes, especially when working with dual forms, tips and in the curing process for extensions on templates.

Intuitive operation

The device is equipped with a touch control button. Pressing it once activates the 20-second operating mode, while holding it down (for about 2 seconds) switches the operating time to 60 seconds. The ergonomic design allows the light to be precisely directed to the selected styling area .

Charging indicator and power supply

The lamp has a built-in battery and a USB charging function. A red light illuminates during charging, and a blue light illuminates when the battery is fully charged. Continuous operation time on a single charge is up to 40 minutes.

Modern design and aesthetic finish

The slim, elongated form with ergonomic proportions and a decorative, grooved surface ensures a secure grip and a modern look. The delicate colour transition in shades of turquoise and pastel pink gives the device a lightness.

Note: For some nail polish colours, such as black or white, double curing (120 seconds) is recommended.

Included: lamp, USB-C cable.

Specifications:
Colour: shades of pink and turquoise
Timer: 20 s, 60 s
Wavelengths: 365 + 405 nm
Power: 3 W
Battery: 180 mAh

item.name: Glow 112 UV LED lamp
item.description:
GLOW products are professional lighting solutions that improve the performance of services in both beauty salons and medical clinics. The range includes a wide selection of specialist lamps, including UV and treatment lamps, which are essential for precision work.

The perfect manicure at your fingertips

The Glow 112 UV/LED lamp with a mirrored bottom allows for precise curing of hybrid varnishes, gels and other light-curing preparations. Properly spaced diodes and Dual LED technology ensure even and durable curing of the styling, while the minimalist design and intuitive operation increase the comfort of work in the salon and at home.

Perfect curing thanks to Dual LED technology

The shadowless lamp with 39 LEDs evenly cures gels and hybrid varnishes. The closed booth design and light-reflecting mirrored bottom make the curing process faster and more accurate, even in hard-to-reach areas of the nail plate. Dual LED technology emits light at two wavelengths, which significantly reduces eye strain and increases comfort.

Precise operating time settings

The lamp has a timer with four pre-programmed operating times: 15 s, 30 s, 60 s and 90 s ( "Low Heat Mode"), displayed on a clear digital screen. A built-in motion sensor automatically activates the device when you insert your hand or foot, using the last selected time option. The screen displays the elapsed curing time, allowing you to precisely adjust the exposure time to the styling you are performing.

Low Heat Mode

When Low Heat Mode is activated , the lamp heats up gradually, slowly increasing the power, which allows for comfortable curing without a burning or hot sensation. This function is particularly useful for gels that can cause discomfort. This makes the curing process more comfortable and protects the nails from excessive heat.

Minimalist design and functionality

The lamp housing is made of durable plastic and combines a modern, minimalist design with practical application. The lamp is easy to clean, resistant to damage and has dimensions that allow for comfortable positioning of the entire hand or foot, ensuring quick and even curing of the styling. The removable magnetic bottom facilitates pedicures as well as cleaning and disinfecting the device, increasing comfort and hygiene in the salon.

Please read the instructions carefully before use.

Modern SPA lounge for complete care and relaxation

The elegant Gabbiano Head Spa Maldives bed with integrated wash unit is an innovative solution designed for professional care and relaxation treatments. The Gabbiano Head Spa Maldives combines tradition with modernity, providing deep relaxation, nourishment and hydration of the scalp and hair. What is a Japanese Head Spa?

Japanese Head SPA is a comprehensive treatment combining scalp massage techniques with advanced care. Thanks to scrubs, masks, and aromatic oils, the skin is thoroughly cleansed, nourished and moisturised, while hair regains its strength and shine. A gentle massage stimulates microcirculation, reduces tension and supports natural hair growth. The treatment not only prevents hair loss, but also significantly improves its condition – hair becomes stronger, more moisturised, and resistant to damage. Head SPA is more than just a beauty treatment – it's an experience that combines care with deep relaxation. 

Luxurious Waterfall Head SPA hydromassage

The golden arch with an adjustable inclination angle, designed for the Waterfall Head SPA, is an innovative solution that enables comprehensive scalp care. Water jets act as a natural massage, improving blood circulation, reducing tension and stress, and bringing relief from ailments such as headaches and neck stiffness. Precisely controlled water flow promotes hair regeneration and intensely moisturises the skin. Thanks to an intelligent closed-loop system, the arch draws water from the basin and reuses it, providing a continuous water massage. A combination of technology and relaxation that supports hair health and well-being. 

Effective steam therapy

The set includes a specialised steam-generating device and a dedicated sink cover that allows for precise treatment. This modern care method uses the properties of steam to intensively regenerate and moisturise hair. This allows the active ingredients contained in masks, ampoules and other products to penetrate deeper, supporting hair repair and strengthening. Steam therapy improves hair structure, increases resistance to damage and restores a healthy shine, making hair soft, supple and full of life. 

Touch control panel

The intuitive touch panel allows for full control over treatment parameters and ease of use. It allows you to adjust the operating time and water temperature, as well as monitor their current values on a clear, easy-to-read display. Additionally, the panel allows you to activate the light therapy function, which illuminates the bowl, creating an atmosphere of relaxation and luxury. The set also includes a remote control, which allows you to conveniently control the steam therapy device from a distance.

Features for treatment versatility

The adjustable headrest, with the option of extending and changing the angle of inclination, allows for a perfect adjustment to the user's needs, ensuring maximum comfort. The set also includes ergonomic cushions, including a headrest with a face opening, which expands the range of applications – from scalp treatments to massages and various body and facial therapies. These practical features make the lounger a versatile piece of equipment for beauty and wellness salons, combining customer comfort with the functionality needed by the professional.

Stylish washbasin for comfort

The deep plastic basin bowl in an elegant shade of white effectively reduces splashing of water and cosmetics, ensuring a clean environment and comfortable work. Made of durable materials, it is resistant to discolouration, scratches, and damage, and its smooth surface makes hygiene maintenance quick and easy. The combination of functionality and modern design elevates the standard of any professional space.

Thoughtful amenities and accessories

The wash unit is equipped with a mixer tap, allowing for precise adjustment of water temperature to the client's needs. A dedicated space for the shower head improves efficiency, while a chrome-plated plug with a special strainer ensures water flow control and maintains a high level of hygiene. The water connection is located inside the base, behind the fabric, aesthetically concealing the plumbing and giving the entire unit an elegant look. The ergonomically contoured bed ensures comfort during various beauty treatments. A practical pouffe complements the unit, increasing staff comfort and enhancing the functionality of the unit. These features make the wash unit ideal for both hair and SPA salons. 

Stability and comfort in an elegant design

The ergonomically profiled surface in shades of black, covered with soft fabric, guarantees complete comfort during treatments. item.description:
Nghia offers stainless steel products, including professional manicure tools that significantly enhance the quality of everyday life for beauty industry clients. The brand’s goal is to effectively meet consumer needs by offering products of the highest quality.

Precision tool for perfect cuticles

Professional Nghia Export C-35 cuticle nippers are made of high-quality stainless steel, ensuring high resistance to damage and dulling. They are ideal for manicure and pedicure treatments, especially for precise cuticle work. The tool is suitable for sterilisation in an autoclave, meeting the standards of professional salons.

Solutions for high working comfort

A single spring connects the arms of the nippers, providing control and cutting precision. Careful workmanship allows for comfortable, quiet and smooth operation. Proper profiling and optimal arm size ensure that the nippers sit securely in the hand, guaranteeing comfort even during prolonged treatments. The matte finish emphasises the elegant character of the tools while also ensuring durability and ease of cleaning. As a result, the nippers are suitable both for professional use and for nail care at home.

Perfectly profiled blades

5 mm long blades allow for precise procedures requiring exceptional accuracy. The distinctive cutting profile combined with the appropriate jaw size makes work control easier. The jaws are connected using the Crescent Joint method, ensuring perfect contact during use and providing accurate, clean cuts. The included blade cover made of durable plastic minimises the risk of damage and extends the service life of the nippers.

Maintenance instructions:

• After use, remove residue from the blades using acetone;
• Immerse the tool in a disinfectant solution;
• Lubricate the inner part of the blades with machine oil;
• Apply the cover to protect the tool from chipping;
• Never place the nippers with the blades facing downwards;
• Always store in a horizontal position.
Note. Store in a dry and safe place. Keep out of reach of children.

Specifications:
Blade length: 5 mm
Total length of nippers: 10.5 cm
Material: stainless steel

The set includes two cushions, which further increase the comfort of the body position and allow for better adjustment to the individual needs of the client.

Modern design and ergonomics

The treatment chair is filled with foam of optimal hardness, ensuring stable and comfortable body support.
